Title: AgentAuth - AI Agent | Pricing, Reviews & Alternatives
Authentication layer enabling AI agents to securely access 250+ apps on users' behalf. AgentAuth is a developer-focused authentication layer designed to empower AI agents with secure, seamless access to over 250 popular applications. Tailored for AI agents, it simplifies the complexities of authentication by supporting OAuth 2.0, API keys, JWT, and more. With built-in support for leading agentic frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, and LlamaIndex, AgentAuth ensures that AI agents can interact with tools such as Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, and Google Calendar without manual integration overhead. By handling the intricacies of authentication, AgentAuth allows developers to focus on building innovative, user-centric AI solutions. The old AgentAuth URL now redirects to agents.composio.dev, while Composio's current documentation incorporates per-user authentication into its broader agent tool-execution platform. This listing is best understood as authentication and action infrastructure for agents, not as a standalone agent that completes end-user work by itself. Composio maps each agent user to isolated connected accounts, stores and refreshes credentials, and keeps one user's tool calls from using another user's accounts. Agents can surface a hosted Connect Link when a required account is missing, wait for authorization, and then retry the tool call without developers building a separate auth UI. The current platform combines authentication with tool discovery and action execution across more than 1,400 apps, plus triggers, SDKs, CLI access, and hosted MCP sessions. * Developers building agents that must connect each end user to third-party accounts and execute actions under isolated user identities.,. Pro is $29 per month with usage credit and metered overage; Enterprise is custom-priced.
